Exploring Evolutionary Spirituality

Tim Freke and Andrew Cohen, London 4th November

In July 2017, Andrew Cohen arranged to meet spiritual teacher Tim Freke at a restaurant in Central London. As a result of their conversation, Andrew invited Tim to participate in a public dialogue about evolutionary spirituality.

The meeting took place on 4th November 2017 at the Grange Strathmore Hotel in London. The event was filmed, and this is their conversation in its entirety.

New Year Retreat January 4th-7th 2018

New Year is traditionally a time when we give renewed priority to our highest aspirations. What could be a higher priority than our own spiritual evolution?

Join Andrew Cohen in the South of France for three days of teaching at the beautiful Zero Gravity Retreat Centre in La Ciotat…
